recommended_usage: swallowed with water || take without food
single_dose: Adults 15 mg - 30 mg daily || Children 2.5 mg - 7.5 mg daily
mechanism_of_action: Inhibits cyclooxygenase (COX) enzymes, reducing prostaglandin synthesis.
side_effects: Nausea, Dizziness, Headache, Edema, Gastrointestinal upset, Rash
unsuitable_population: Patients with renal impairment, Hypertension, Asthma, Allergy to meloxicam
storage_conditions: store at room temperature || keep tightly closed
